new: Moving with the sticks in a shared room: a VR headset that is elsewhere (it answered Somewhere else) can now move with the sticks (click a stick twice). The others see it move, and moving into a circle with the sticks enters it, Back to the lobby too. In the room with the others it stays off: there you walk for real.
Studio, Follow: a Faces row. Them turns it to look at the person; Where they look faces the way they look. It works with every side (In front, Behind, Left, Right).
Studio, Follow an item: a Faces row. The item turns it to look at the item it follows; As placed keeps the turn it is placed at with that item.

Studio: a recorded path has a timeline too, under its Recorded path rows: Pause / Play, Start, −1 s, +1 s, The scene's clock and a slider on a page. Back and forth is one cycle there and back. A voice recorded with the movement follows it.

Studio, headset card: a timeline bar under each Timeline row (a model's clip and a recorded path). Point at it and press or drag with the trigger to move it; it stays held there for everyone at the circle.
Studio: Lock in place is now the first row on every card, right under the name.
The Vive trackers' bridge runs with uv: uv run tools/trackers/bridge.py fetches Python and openvr by itself the first time (winget install astral-sh.uv once).
test: Two headsets in a room, one in VR answering Somewhere else: click a stick twice, move into a circle and into Back to the lobby, and watch it move from the other headset. Then answer In this room in the menu and check you are back where you stand.
Studio at a circle: a model on Follow, Behind or at your Left, with Faces: Them; walk about. Then Faces: Where they look.
Studio: Follow an item with Faces: The item; move or animate the item it follows.

Studio, a model with a recorded path, editing on, selected: Pause, slide, −1 s, +1 s, Play, The scene's clock; at a circle with a second headset, check both see the same moment and that deselecting gives it back.
In the headset, the same with the new bar on the card: drag the playhead, for a model's own clip too (also a short one, about 1.3 s).
A recorded path with your voice: pause it on its timeline (silent), play it from the middle (the voice from there).
Lock in place at the top of the card, on a page and in the headset.
On the trackers' PC: winget install astral-sh.uv, then uv run tools/trackers/bridge.py --list.
A v127 device and a v128 device in one room: the older one is asked to reload (format networks-40).
untested: Everything on a real headset: how moving with the sticks elsewhere feels and how the others see a moving avatar over Wi-Fi; a recentre or a sleep while moved.
Faces on a headset: being looked at by a follower beside or behind you; an item turning to the one it follows, life size.
The headset's timeline bar: how it reads and drags with a real trigger, and its cost on a Quest (its strip redrawn up to ten times a second).
A held path's voice heard in Quest Browser.
uv on Windows, and the bridge with SteamVR and real trackers (still to be switched on).
